summary: Retest of the iteration_207 fixes on TEST_DcOrg. Backend: 16/17 pytest pass (new file 11/12 + iter207 regression 6/6). UI: all requested flows pass. (1) PersonMask Stato select (mask-assign-stato-0) has the 7 options in order. Da classificare UiCov set to Volontario + Confermato and saved: fx-avail M/P went 0->1 and the person is in the fx-open dialog. Rinunciato: 0/0, person gone. Staff + Confermato: 1/1, no double count. New rows (Aggiungi Volontario and mask-add-event) default to Da contattare. (2) Mobile 390px: m-delete-request-{id} is visible on Da classificare cards. The dialog (bottom sheet) has the correct text. Annulla keeps the card. Confirm removes it, the count goes 6->5, and no card detail dialog opens from click bubbling. (3) Restore duplicate: fixed when the person is kept (has another event). Delete request, re-register via the public form with the same email, then restore: still exactly 1 EV1 link and 1 availability. Re-linking via the API also works. NOT fixed for an orphan person, which is the usual Da classificare case: delete request (person deleted), re-register via the public form (new person created because the email is gone), then restore. Result: 2 persons with the same email and 2 EV1 Da classificare links. (4) Bulk fascia preview: API and UI (cov-bulk-open) list only confirmed Staff/Volontari. A Da classificare+confermato person and a volontario da_contattare with the same mansione are excluded. Regression: desktop delete (two-event select, confirm), org admin has no 'Richieste eliminate', SA restore via UI + toast, the Staff/Volontari/Da classificare/Team/Gruppi/Turni/Copertura tabs (no page errors), and cov-print-fasce / cov-print-fasce-names downloads all pass.

minor.issue: The duplicate check is by persona_id+evento_id only. When the deleted request was an orphan (person removed) and the same person re-registers via the public form, a NEW person id is created. Restore then re-inserts the old person + old link, giving 2 persons with the same email/cellulare and 2 Da classificare links on the same event. Reproduced in test_restore_orphan_after_public_form (persons_with_email=2, ev1_links=2). Suggest: before restoring a person doc, look for an existing person in the org with the same email/cellulare/codice_fiscale. If one exists, skip the person insert and remap staff/availabilities to it, or skip them when that person already has a link/availability for the event. Or return a 409 telling SA the person re-registered.

issues: Data di nascita still uses the native date input (pre-existing, noted in 207)

action_items: MEDIUM: deleted_requests_restore orphan case: dedupe the restored person against an existing person (email/cellulare/CF) created after deletion, e.g. by public-form re-registration. Otherwise you get a duplicate anagrafica and 2 Da classificare links for the same event.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py restore: the staff/availability skip uses d.get('persona_id') of the OLD person. It cannot detect a re-registered person with a new id (see above).

PersonMask: existing rows with an unknown/legacy stato value would display as the first option (no fallback option). Today the DB only has confermato/da_contattare/disponibile/rinunciato, so this is OK.
server.py is >10k lines (pre-existing): consider splitting the deleted_requests and public availability modules.
